recent.text: The #Jets didn't win today because of Sterling Shepherd. They won because their 2nd year right tackle, 3rd year left tackle, 4th year guard and free agent addition at guard battered the Chargers DL for their two young RBs....also because their rookie 2nd overall pick was dominant
